translation.Install PackRat Lighting Companion on th: Install PackRat Lighting Companion on this Windows PC. Open its local setup page, pair Philips Hue and/or Govee, then copy the Companion Pairing Token here. Philips Hue and Govee credentials stay in the local companion, not in this widget.
